cards.objective: Distinguish history ownership from snapshot storage
cards.prompt: Which component manages history without inspecting snapshot contents?
cards.hint: Separate the owner of history from a single stored snapshot.
cards.explanation: The Caretaker manages the collection while the Memento stores one state.
cards.misconception: Confusing a stored snapshot with the manager of its history.
